ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider's original payment method; void the no-show fee on the record (driver's 4 min 50 s wait did not satisfy the 5-minute free wait), and note the driver's on-time arrival/contact attempts as mitigating.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat (F10, F11), the driver's statement (F14) and the complaint contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; nothing suggests an accident or anyone feeling unsafe. safety_concern = none.

No-show fee must satisfy all NS-1 conditions. (i) Arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:32:45, 40 m from the pickup point [F7], and GPS places him within 200 m from 21:32:00 [F2]; arrival is established. (iii) Contact: before cancelling he sent 2 in-app messages (first 21:33:15) and made 1 in-app call (21:34:15) [F5, F10, F11, F13] — met. (iv) Presence: he stayed within 200 m throughout, stationary 21:32:45–21:37:35 [F2, F3, F7] — met. (ii) The 5-minute free wait: the wait runs from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival [NS-1, C4]. There is no no-show threshold in the record, so the free wait is 5 minutes counted from 21:32:45. Cancellation was at 21:37:35, only 4 min 50 s after arrival [F4, F6, F7]; cumulative time within 200 m was 5 min 35 s [F2] but that clock started at 21:32:00, i.e. before the arrival tap, and the policy counts from the later of arrival and scheduled pickup time, not from first proximity. The driver's own message "More than 5 min already" [F11] measures from when he got near the pickup, which is not the NS-1 trigger. Condition (ii) therefore fails by 10 seconds.

Any NS-1 condition failing → refund_full of $5.00 [NS-2]; the fee stands only if all four hold, and here one does not. The refund is the fixed fee amount, so the ruling is refund_full of $5.00 on the $5.00 charge [F4, F8]. No account flag: the driver did mark arrival from within 200 m of the pickup point [F7], so NS-2's flag trigger does not apply. Surge is 1.0× [F9], no route issue arises, and the profiles [F18, F19] do not decide the case; the driver's repeat no-show record is not a flag ground under NS-2.

Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel with zero contact, refunded $5.00) aligns in the sense that a no-show fee fails whenever an NS-1 condition is unmet; here the failure is the wait clock rather than contact. Evidence is complete (GPS, timeline, timestamped messages, who cancelled), so no escalation under TH-3/TH-4. Amount $5.00 is under $10: system ruling is final (TH-1).

element_findings.element: N o-show fee stands — condition (i) driver arrived at pickup (I'm Here / auto-arrival, GPS within 200 m)
element_findings.reason: Driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:32:45 40 m from the pickup point and GPS shows him within 200 m from 21:32:00 [F2, F7].

element_findings.element: No-show fee stands — condition (ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancellation (counted from later of scheduled pickup time and arrival; no record threshold)
element_findings.reason: Arrival 21:32:45, cancellation 21:37:35 → 4 min 50 s elapsed, 10 seconds short of the 5-minute free wait [F4, F6, F7]. The 5 min 35 s within 200 m [F2] runs from 21:32:00, which is not the NS-1 start point.

element_findings.element: No-show fee stands — condition (iii) before cancelling, ≥1 in-app message AND ≥1 in-app call
element_findings.reason: 2 timestamped in-app messages from 21:33:15 and 1 in-app call at 21:34:15, all before the 21:37:35 cancellation [F5, F12, F13].

element_findings.element: No-show fee stands — condition (iv) driver stayed at the pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: Driver stationary 21:32:45–21:37:35 at 40 m from the pickup point and within 200 m continuously; no GPS gap [F2, F3, F7].

element_findings.element: Reason for cancellation (NS-0: rider no-show vs other reason; the reason picked in-app is the driver's claim, his words decide)
element_findings.reason: App reason is rider_no_show and his chat and statement both say he waited for the rider [F4, F11, F14]; the dispute is genuinely a no-show case governed by NS-1/NS-2.

element_findings.element: NS-2 flag trigger — driver marked arrival while GPS was not at the pickup point
element_findings.reason: "I'm Here" was tapped 40 m from the pickup point within the 200 m radius [F7]; no fraudulent-arrival flag basis.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's chat and statement that he had waited "more than 5 min" measures the wait from when he first came within 200 m (21:32:00) or before the arrival tap; NS-1 counts the free wait from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival (21:32:45), giving only 4 min 50 s [F4, F6, F7].

Statement evidence — the driver's written account is a claim; the system records (arrival tap, cancellation timestamps, continuous GPS) override it where they conflict, and they show the wait fell 10 seconds short.
